answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like island, ledge, inlet, and every agent must weave them into a short signed response proving fresh reasoning, not stored templates. Since words arrive after templates are cached, precomputed sybil answers are worthless; each identity needs real per-epoch computation. An attacker flooding fake identities pays compute per ID per epoch, so cost scales linearly with sybils instead of being one-time, making mass fake identity unprofitable.
